user.title: Connect Lunch Money
user.description:
Home Assistant needs an access token to read your balances.

In Lunch Money, open **Settings › Developers** ({developers_url}) and choose **Request new access token**. Give it a label you will recognise later — something like `Home Assistant` — then copy the token and paste it below.

The token is read-only as far as this integration is concerned: it only ever fetches accounts and asks Lunch Money to refresh from your banks. It never changes your data.

data_description.api_key: The token is stored in Home Assistant and never leaves it, except in requests to Lunch Money.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Lunch Money
reauth_confirm.description:
Lunch Money is no longer accepting the stored token for **{budget_name}**. This usually means the token was revoked or regenerated.

Create a new one under **Settings › Developers** ({developers_url}) and paste it below. Your existing sensors and their recorded history are kept.

data_description.api_key: Must belong to the same Lunch Money budget as before.

error.invalid_auth: Lunch Money rejected that token. Check that you copied all of it, and that it has not been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Lunch Money. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Lunch Money is rate limiting this connection. Wait a minute and try again.
error.no_account: That token works, but it is not attached to a Lunch Money budget. Create the token from inside the budget you want to track.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Lunch Money budget has already been added.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Lunch Money budget. Use a token from the same budget, or add the other budget as a separate integration.

init.title: Lunch Money options
init.description: How often to check, and which accounts to include.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Lunch Money for balances. Lunch Money itself only syncs with your banks a few times a day, so checking more often than every 15 minutes rarely shows you anything new.
data_description.include_closed: Create sensors for accounts you have closed in Lunch Money. Off by default, because a closed account's balance never changes again.
data_description.api_version: Leave this on Automatic. It picks the current API and falls back to the older one if the current one stops working. Only pin a version if you have been asked to.
